details:
Some quality of life changes would be nice to have for the worlds browsing experience. A list of some basic ideas: 

-See more images than one thumbnail of a world. Some worlds have video showcase, but you can only see those if you show the world in browser, would be nice if you could play those in-game.

- Show an indicator if you have already visited a world before.

- Remember your last search, tab and scroll location after loading into a new world. (retyping your search in vr, esp if it's long kinda suck)

- Ability to hide select worlds from being recommended to you again or showing up every time you open your menu panel.

- Show actual reachable people in addition to actual player number.

- Search by popular tags feature, blacklist tags. 

- Option to show some rough performance stats on the thumbnail. Idk how this would be best done, but some worlds have no clue how to optimize anything at all so it would be nice to have some indicator for that. Also an option to hide platforms indicator if you find it unnecessary.

- Estimated loading time based off of your current or recent speed metrics.

- Some worlds come with loud media players upon joining. it would be nice to have user-side option to override default world media volume, start muted or automatically pause it, rather than embarking on a journey to look around for the media player, or add a volume right into the player's menu.
title: Update world search / browsing
